coverage: All 30 evidence profiles and identification dossiers reviewed against current community references on 14 September 2026. Media dates are shown separately; check source updates after game patches.

ghosts.name: Spirit
ghosts.summary: An ordinary-looking ghost with an unusually long incense hunt-prevention window.
ghosts.test: Time a confirmed incense cleanse. A normal hunt inside three minutes conflicts with Spirit; waiting longer alone does not prove it.
ghosts.caution: Do not confuse hunt prevention with the brief protection during an active hunt.

ghosts.name: Wraith
ghosts.summary: A roaming suspect that does not disturb salt.
ghosts.test: Confirm that the ghost actually crossed the pile. An untouched pile by itself proves nothing.
ghosts.caution: Gallu can also avoid salt in its enraged state, and The Mimic can copy behaviour.

ghosts.name: Phantom
ghosts.summary: Known for long invisible intervals during a hunt.
ghosts.test: Observe visibility carefully or investigate its photograph interaction outside a hunt.
ghosts.caution: A photo taken as an event ends is not a reliable confirmation.

ghosts.name: Poltergeist
ghosts.summary: Look for a burst of several object throws at once.
ghosts.test: Gather loose objects and watch for a simultaneous multi-throw.
ghosts.caution: One impressive throw is not enough. Keep The Mimic in consideration.

ghosts.name: Banshee
ghosts.summary: Its target-focused behaviour and special microphone scream can be useful clues.
ghosts.test: Listen through a Parabolic Microphone or Sound Recorder. Compare a suspected call with the contextual recording.
ghosts.caution: Ordinary singing is not the distinctive Banshee scream.

ghosts.name: Jinn
ghosts.summary: Fuse-box power affects its special chase behaviour.
ghosts.test: Record whether the ghost directly switches the breaker off, excluding overloads.
ghosts.caution: Ordinary electrical activity does not establish a Jinn.

ghosts.name: Mare
ghosts.summary: Light conditions matter to this ghost's hunting behaviour.
ghosts.test: Observe actual light-switch interactions, distinguishing lights from the breaker.
ghosts.caution: A light switched off just after you turn it on can happen by chance.

ghosts.name: Revenant
ghosts.summary: Its hunt speed differs sharply when it detects a player.
ghosts.test: Compare footsteps while undetected with a controlled observation of detection.
ghosts.caution: Speed settings and detection conditions matter; do not assume every fast ghost is a Revenant.

ghosts.name: Shade
ghosts.summary: Its activity can be suppressed by players near it.
ghosts.test: Give it room and retry evidence collection from outside its current room.
ghosts.caution: A quiet investigation is not enough to identify a Shade.

ghosts.name: Demon
ghosts.summary: Can attempt unusually early hunts.
ghosts.test: Record the exact circumstances and timing of an early normal hunt.
ghosts.caution: Cursed hunts and other special abilities can also produce early hunts.

ghosts.name: Yurei
ghosts.summary: Certain door interactions can be more informative than ordinary activity.
ghosts.test: Distinguish an ability-related door closure from a door closing during an event.
ghosts.caution: A slammed door on its own is not a confirmation.

ghosts.name: Oni
ghosts.summary: Hunt visibility is useful when comparing it with a Phantom.
ghosts.test: Compare visible and invisible intervals during a clear hunt observation.
ghosts.caution: General activity and frequent events are only supporting clues.

ghosts.name: Yokai
ghosts.summary: Voice proximity and limited detection during hunts affect its behaviour.
ghosts.test: Compare detection cautiously while accounting for walls, distance and equipment.
ghosts.caution: A single missed detection is inconclusive.

ghosts.name: Hantu
ghosts.summary: Its movement is linked to room temperature.
ghosts.test: Compare hunt pace across warmer and colder rooms.
ghosts.caution: It must provide freezing when the contract gives at least one evidence.

ghosts.name: Goryo
ghosts.summary: Its D.O.T.S. silhouette is camera-only, under the right room conditions.
ghosts.test: Observe D.O.T.S. through a camera with nobody in the ghost's room, then compare direct viewing.
ghosts.caution: Seeing D.O.T.S. on camera alone is not unique; many ghosts appear on camera.

ghosts.name: Myling
ghosts.summary: Its quieter hunt sounds can help distinguish it.
ghosts.test: Compare audible footsteps and nearby electronics carefully on the same floor.
ghosts.caution: Different floors, sound settings and distance can mislead.

ghosts.name: Onryo
ghosts.summary: Flames interact with its hunt behaviour.
ghosts.test: Track extinguished flames and hunt attempts with protection in place.
ghosts.caution: One candle going out is normal behaviour, not a confirmation.

ghosts.name: The Twins
ghosts.summary: Interactions and hunt pace may suggest different activity locations.
ghosts.test: Log successive interactions and compare multiple hunts under similar conditions.
ghosts.caution: There are not two independently hunting ghosts.

ghosts.name: Raiju
ghosts.summary: Active electronic equipment can affect its hunt speed.
ghosts.test: Compare its pace near and away from active equipment.
ghosts.caution: Touching electrical objects often is not the same as this speed effect.

ghosts.name: Obake
ghosts.summary: Unusual UV prints and a brief model change during a hunt are notable clues.
ghosts.test: Inspect prints promptly and look for a clearly different model during a hunt.
ghosts.caution: Missing one print does not safely rule out ultraviolet.

ghosts.name: The Mimic
ghosts.summary: Copies behaviours while retaining its own evidence and extra ghost orbs.
ghosts.test: Check for orbs even when the difficulty gives no evidence.
ghosts.caution: Orbs are additional to its evidence budget, and copied behaviour can imitate another ghost.

ghosts.name: Moroi
ghosts.summary: Its hunt pace changes with team sanity.
ghosts.test: Compare pace only when sanity and speed modifiers are known.
ghosts.caution: Spirit Box is forced when at least one evidence is available.

ghosts.name: Deogen
ghosts.summary: Fast when far away, much slower near its target; hiding is not its usual counter.
ghosts.test: Check for the distinctive close-range Spirit Box breathing response.
ghosts.caution: Do not start a hunt test without an escape route and an understanding of its tracking.

ghosts.name: Thaye
ghosts.summary: Can become less active and slower as it ages near players.
ghosts.test: Compare activity and hunt pace over time with controlled settings.
ghosts.caution: A single slow hunt does not prove ageing.

ghosts.name: Dayan
ghosts.summary: Nearby player movement can alter its behaviour.
ghosts.test: Record whether movement near the ghost consistently changes its hunt pace.
ghosts.caution: Other nearby players can affect the comparison.

ghosts.name: Gallu
ghosts.summary: Protective equipment can change its state.
ghosts.test: Record salt interactions and protection use together, rather than in isolation.
ghosts.caution: An enraged Gallu can leave salt undisturbed, so salt avoidance is not exclusive to Wraith.

ghosts.name: Obambo
ghosts.summary: Alternates between calm and aggressive states.
ghosts.test: Compare multiple hunts and record when its behaviour changes.
ghosts.caution: Its state can change; one observation is only part of the picture.

ghosts.name: Aswang
ghosts.summary: Its base pace is 1.53 m/s, but chase acceleration builds faster than normal.
ghosts.test: Identify an available game-defined hiding place. Record the approach and whether the hunt ended early.
ghosts.caution: Furniture corners and blocked hiding spots do not qualify.

ghosts.name: Kormos
ghosts.summary: It can detect player footsteps, with longer ranges for sprinting than crouch-walking.
ghosts.test: Stay out of its likely path and stop voice and electronic cues. Compare its response to movement on the same floor.
ghosts.caution: Check for freezing before choosing it over an orb-producing Mimic.

ghosts.name: Deildegast
ghosts.summary: It starts at 3 m/s and loses 0.1 m/s per qualifying unique object touched outside hunts, down to 0.4 m/s.
ghosts.test: Interact with multiple distinct qualifying objects before a hunt. Listen for a lower fixed pace without chase acceleration.
ghosts.caution: Repeat after the reset; moving one object repeatedly is not equivalent.
